description: Java enum representing various states of grouping type status in a financial or group management application.

classes.name: GroupingTypeStatus
classes.description: Enum representing grouping status states with associated integer codes and string identifiers, including methods for state checks and conversions.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Static factory method to obtain a GroupingTypeStatus enum value from an integer status code.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current status matches the provided status.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer code associated with the status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code identifier for the status.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Checks if the status is PENDING.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the status is ACTIVE.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the status is CLOSED.

methods.name: isTransferInProgress
methods.description: Checks if the status is TRANSFER_IN_PROGRESS.

methods.name: isTransferOnHold
methods.description: Checks if the status is TRANSFER_ON_HOLD.

methods.name: isUnderTransfer
methods.description: Checks if the status indicates a transfer is in progress or on hold.
